comparisonPolicy.raw: Full own enumerable observations and exact physical UTF-8/base64 bytes are retained. Own undefined fields are separately enumerated. No raw ID, clock, cwd, parent link, record or path is replaced.
comparisonPolicy.contract: A separately named derivation projects checkpoint counts, ordered entry types, runtime/LLM roles and text, model/thinking settings, full custom state and hidden-message payloads; it also evaluates declared within-run identity, ancestry, parent-file and byte-preservation relations.
comparisonPolicy.omittedFieldsRetainedAt: cases[].rawObservations (and the retained scratch JSONL files); omissions affect only explicit cross-run contract comparison.
comparisonPolicy.repeatRule: Two fresh runs must have equal derived contracts and loaded module pins. Raw observations may differ because real clocks, random identifiers and fresh paths are used.
comparisonPolicy.modelInputs: No provider execution. Ordinary user/assistant inputs and custom payloads are finite authored data. Custom state is raw session data; display:false custom messages contribute to context and public convertToLlm.
comparisonPolicy.scope: Eight concrete SessionManager lifecycle schedules; no original package, full phase, provider, compaction or native parity closure claim.
